verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents version and deploy tracking: it shows which code versions are throwing exceptions, unlocks features when deploys are reported, and is marketed as connecting errors and releases. That gives a thin per-release error view an SRE could use to roughly compare versions. Nothing in the evidence describes crash-free session or user rates, release adoption metrics, or a canary-vs-stable comparison view. Missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, per-release adoption tracking, canary vs last-stable comparison, detailed docs on the versions view, independent corroboration.
